COD.note: Nothing on the central bank or payments oversight.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
Names no startup law, strategy or public fund; Silikin is privately backed by Texaf with donor support.

facts.fact: Silikin Village in Kinshasa, backed by the Texaf Group, says it has supported over 300 project leaders and entrepreneurs in five years and is launching the 'Grow & Help Grow' acceleration programme, whose first cohort of five tech entrepreneurs will run nine months.
